data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obadiah total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: עובדיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמעו, יהוה, 'עבד' - שם - של - עבד - י - י- ה - 'א - (Obadiah), 'servant - of - the - Lord' - name - of a prophet in the Old Testament (Obadiah, 1 Kings 18:3, 2 Kings 13:14 - 'Hebrew Bible - Old Testament').

in_greek.name: Ωβηδιας
in_greek.long_meaning: ὀπίσω, ὑπάρχων - 'ὀπίσω - ὑπάρχων' - (Obadiah), 'servant' - or 'one who serves' - in the New Testament (Luke 11:29 - 'Greek New Testament').

in_latin.name: Obadiah
in_latin.long_meaning: servus, Domini, nomen prophetae in Veteri Testamento (Obadiah, 1 Regum 18:3, 2 Regum 13:14 - 'Vetus Testamentum').
